description: This file contains the implementation of the MyRssReader4 Android activity, which manages RSS feed display, user interactions, and menu options in an RSS reader application.

classes.name: MyRssReader4
classes.description: Main activity class for RSS reading, managing UI, data binding, and user interactions.

classes.name: MyRssReader4.RssCursorAdapter
classes.description: Internal class extending SimpleCursorAdapter to customize list item views with font styles based on read status.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity, sets layout, binds data to list view, restores last state.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Creates options menu with start, stop, add, delete, and update options.

methods.name: onPrepareOptionsMenu
methods.description: Prepares options menu for display; placeholder for dynamic menu adjustment.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections: start/stop service, add/delete items, trigger updates.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles result from adding new RSS item, inserts data into content provider, updates list.
